name: Ju-Kao Engineering Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 1963 and headquartered in Kaohsiung City, Taiwan, Ju-Kao Engineering Co., Ltd. offers a comprehensive range of engineering and construction services. Their core activities include maintaining steel frames and structures, performing cold work on heavy machinery, and general mechanical processing. The company provides installation, repair, and maintenance for a wide array of industrial equipment, such as diesel generators, blowers, steam turbines, chemical machinery, and cranes. They also specialize in the design, construction, and fabrication of factory buildings, steel frame structures, and other mechanical equipment. Their infrastructure expertise covers the design and construction of substations and wiring systems, as well as the implementation and upkeep of automatic control systems. They engineer solutions for refrigeration, air conditioning, cooling water, electrical, and fire protection systems. Ju-Kao's capabilities extend to general building construction, hydraulic engineering, and extensive earthwork, including surveying and exploration. Furthermore, they undertake specialized projects such as SRC steel structure construction, floating docks, harbor engineering, and complete turnkey solutions for industrial plants. They construct various environmental control systems, including dust collection, conveying, soil and air pollution control, noise reduction, hydraulic machinery, pumping, and water/sewage treatment equipment. The company also fabricates and pipes oil, tower, storage, and pressure vessels, and performs metal painting and coating. Additionally, Ju-Kao Engineering provides a diverse set of specialized services, including landscape engineering, the installation of cables, elevators, computer equipment, satellite television, windows, glass, kitchenware, and bathroom fixtures. Their operations also encompass traffic signal systems, drilling, static electricity protection and elimination, the paving of resin materials for sports venue tracks, and nuclear engineering activities.
